skills.description:
【一句话定位】 进了面试却 " 开口就卡壳 " 的考生救星——直接给你五大题型的完整可背逐字稿（1.5~2 分钟） + 答题框架 + 可背热点素材（金句  /  案例），让你照着念就能答，不用自己硬憋。

【核心功能】
-- 题型覆盖：综合分析  /  组织管理  /  应急应变  /  人际关系  /  自我认知，五大类全有。
-- 完整逐字稿：不是提纲、不是思路，是能张嘴就背的成稿（约 300~400 字，标停顿）。
-- 答题框架：每篇稿后附 " 总—分—总 " 三层结构，方便你套同类题。
-- 热点素材：每篇配 2~3 条可背金句或真实案例（如 " 浙江枫桥经验 "  " 基层治理最后一公里 " ）。

【用途场景】
--  " 综合分析题给我一篇逐字稿 "  → 稿 + 框架 + 素材一次到位。
--  " 乡村振兴怎么说？ "  → 给该主题逐字稿与案例。
--  " 应急题卡壳了 "  → 给应急类框架 + 一句破题。

【适用人群】
-- 进面了但一开口就大脑空白、不知道说什么的考生；
-- 背不下来通用模板、需要 " 直接能念的稿子 " 的人；
-- 想用真实案例和金句让回答更有分量、不干巴巴的考生。

【核心优势】
1.  给的是稿子不是提纲：照着念就能答，零基础也能开口。
2.  配热点弹药：金句 + 案例双保险，让回答有记忆点。
3.  给框架能迁移：学会一套结构，同类题自己就能套。
4.  不押题不代考：只给备考素材，不碰违规红线。

【写给离上岸只差 " 说出来 " 的你】
笔试熬了半年，面试只要一张嘴——可偏偏就是这张嘴，让多少人功亏一篑。别让 " 卡壳 " 毁掉你半年的努力。这个库不教你空方法，它直接把一篇篇能背的逐字稿递到你手上，再配上金句和案例。你念熟几篇，进考场那一刻，心里是有底的。

skills.description: Turn a payslip into a contribution-base checkup you can verify, evidence and re-run - social insurance and housing fund, month by month (payslip check / social insurance base / housing fund base / payroll audit / underpaid social insurance / retirement contribution gap / contribution floor and cap). Use when the user says "is my payslip correct", "how is my social insurance calculated", "my employer pays social insurance on the minimum base", "why is my housing fund smaller than my colleague's", "work out my contribution base", "what does underpaying cost me at retirement", "how do I negotiate the contribution base in a salary review", or pastes a payslip CSV and asks to check the last 12 months. Capabilities: (1) derive the real contribution base from the employee deduction alone, even when the payslip never prints it (2) compare against the local floor and cap and sort into four verdicts - below floor, low base, in line, above cap (3) quantify the monthly and annual gap for employee, employer, housing fund and the pension and medical accounts (4) explain what the base is tied to - mortgage limits, residency points, maternity allowance, unemployment benefit (5) give the escalation order with a ready-to-edit HR email and audit filing points (6) keep a month-by-month ledger for the year-end review and for evidence. Do not trigger for: income tax filing, payroll calculation or disbursement, contribution agents or back-payment brokers (illegal or high risk), legal advice or arbitration representation, or a plain lookup of what this year's base is in a given city (read the local bureau notice instead).
skills.description_zh: 【Payroll】Your employer files social insurance on the minimum base and nobody ever showed you the bill. Reverse the real contribution base out of your payslip, compare it with the local floor and cap, and get the monthly gap, the account shortfall and an escalation script. Chinese version: payroll-checkup
skills.name: Payroll Checkup
